title: Older pilots' private UFO stories

tellings.quote: guys, you know, kind of older guys been flying for a while, like they all just seem to have that cool story they tell you, you know, once they had a few drinks in them. [laughter]

plain: Older military pilots who have flown for a long time all seem to have one strange UFO story, which they tell once they have had a few drinks, according to the former Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves. Graves says this to Michels, with a laugh, as something he picked up from those senior aviators, and he does not tell any of the stories himself. It suggests that sightings were common among pilots but were shared only in private.
